561120631battle.h: Utah clings to the edge for D. Iorio as Michigan refuses to fold
561120631battle.d: Five-star SAM [[r:561120631|D. Iorio]] has told people close to him that playing style will decide it. [[t:832438339|Michigan]] is still pushing hard, and [[t:832438319|Indiana]] hasn't gone away.

561125382commit.h: Indiana adds J. Petty, and the sack numbers sold a power rusher

561121023commit.h: Tennessee's pass-happy offense wins over F. Brandon, leaving Alabama and SMU behind

561121915commit.h: Notre Dame gets No. 4 overall B. Arrington with a 'job is yours to win' pitch

561123176commit.d: With one returning quarterback, [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]] gave [[r:561123176|K. Ryan]] a clear look at early work. [[t:832438384|Texas]] and [[t:832438293|Clemson]] couldn't match the path, and the Sooners' NIL money helped.

quote.by: a source close to the recruit

561124114sign.h: Colorado signs five-star athlete C. Virgin on a playing-time pitch
561124114sign.d: Virgin picks Colorado after being told a job is there to compete for from day one. The staff has been selling versatility all cycle, and this was the payoff.

quote.text: They told him he'd touch the ball and he believed them.
quote.by: a person familiar with the recruitment

561119527commit.h: N. Burroughs picks Georgia over Florida State and Georgia Tech
561119527commit.d: Georgia has just two returning receivers, and its NIL spending ranks 3rd. Burroughs reportedly asked for $340K, and the Bulldogs were willing to meet it. Florida State and Georgia Tech were left on the outside.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.

561121982commit.h: D. Geralds chooses Auburn, calling the NFL track record the difference
561121982commit.d: Auburn has sent four defensive linemen to the draft in four years, one in the first round, and has just three returning tackles. Illinois and Michigan both thought they were in good shape late.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.

561120261commit.h: B. Hanks III picks Florida State over Clemson and Auburn
561120261commit.d: With just three returning corners, Florida State offered a quick path to the field. The Seminoles' conference prestige did the rest, and Clemson's staff is said to be disappointed.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.

561125191commit.h: Oregon lands four-star guard D. Lee on a ring-chasing pitch
561125191commit.d: Oregon grades out an A+ as a championship contender and has just two returning guards. Lee's camp reportedly liked how quickly the Ducks laid out his path to the field.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.

561121944commit.h: Iron Bowl win helps Auburn land Z. Helton from Florida and Alabama
561121944commit.d: Auburn's 47-42 rivalry win over Alabama came at just the right time. Helton was in the stands, and the short drive from Carrollton made the decision easier. Alabama's staff reportedly knew the game hurt them.

quote.text: That win over Alabama? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.

557720545:stayed:2027.h: Ohio State keeps A. Rogers after five weeks on Portal Watch
557720545:stayed:2027.d: A. Rogers was buried on the depth chart and looked like a likely departure. He's still on the roster. The Buckeyes needed a win in a week full of bad news, and reportedly got one with a direct sales job.

quote.text: They had to sell him on the plan, and they did.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557724828:stayed:2027.h: Michigan talks flight risk S. Hiter into staying with a bigger NIL deal
557724828:stayed:2027.d: Hiter spent six weeks on Portal Watch while stuck on a losing team. Michigan's answer was money: his NIL rose from 115K to 195K. The decision was not an easy one for him.

quote.text: That one was closer than people think.
quote.by: a person close to the situation

557726826:stayed:2027.h: Penn State holds on to J. Zayas despite scheme-fit chatter
557726826:stayed:2027.d: Zayas had been tagged on Portal Watch as a bad fit, but he's still on the roster. agerm40's staff gets a quiet win during a noisy portal period.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719002:stayed:2027.h: N. Pullard sticks at Penn State after a rating jump
557719002:stayed:2027.d: Pullard's rating bump made him a potential target for bigger offers, but he's remaining with the Nittany Lions. agerm40 needed some stability after a week of departures.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557711879:stayed:2027.h: J. Blue isn't leaving Ohio State, whatever Portal Watch said
557711879:stayed:2027.d: Blue's rating jump had him on the list, but he's still a Buckeye. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff takes a small positive in a rough portal week.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557714154:stayed:2027.h: Ohio State keeps S. Boyce out of the portal
557714154:stayed:2027.d: Boyce was about to get expensive after a rating jump and drew attention elsewhere, but he is staying. The Buckeyes are counting every player they keep.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

832438359:exodus:2027.h: Ohio State loses 19 to the portal, 14 of them four-stars or better
832438359:exodus:2027.d: Chris Henry Jr., Jerquaden Guilford and Tavien St. Clair are among those gone. Tuddy_roosevelt now faces the biggest rebuild in the league, and boosters are said to be watching how fast he responds.

quote.text: You can't lose this many talented players and say it's normal.

832438366:exodus:2027.h: Penn State sees 13 players enter the portal, three of them four-stars
832438366:exodus:2027.d: Jahmir Joseph, Christian Flanagan and Owen Aliciene lead the group out. agerm40 has holes at corner and quarterback, and the next few weeks will show whether he can fill them.

quote.text: It's a lot of change in the secondary and at quarterback.
quote.by: a source close to the program

832438301:exodus:2027.h: East Carolina sees 12 players leave, edge rusher Ethan Wilson among them
832438301:exodus:2027.d: Ethan Wilson, Ashton Gray and Donnell Mitchell lead a dozen portal entries. Pirate_flag now has to find an edge presence and replace depth at skill spots.

quote.text: Losing Wilson hurts. That's the one they'll feel most.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557722831:gone:2027.h: I. West leaves Ohio State, just as TD Wire flagged
557722831:gone:2027.d: West spent four weeks buried on the depth chart and is now in the portal. He is one more name leaving Tuddy_roosevelt's roster.

quote.text: He didn't see playing time coming. It was time to look.
quote.by: a person close to the player

557727811:gone:2027.h: D. Jones leaves Ohio State's depth chart behind for the portal
557727811:gone:2027.d: Jones had been flagged for two weeks, stuck behind others. He's now gone, leaving another hole in Tuddy_roosevelt's rebuild.

quote.text: He wanted a real shot to play and didn't feel he'd get one.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557717122:gone:2027.h: J. Joseph exits Penn State, a scheme mismatch that finally cracked
557717122:gone:2027.d: Joseph had been flagged for three weeks as a bad fit. He's now in the portal. agerm40 loses a four-star corner and a lot of secondary depth.

quote.text: He never felt comfortable in what they asked him to do.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557713037:gone:2027.h: C. Flanagan enters the portal and Penn State needs a quarterback plan
557713037:gone:2027.d: Flanagan's rating jump made him a prime target. He's now in the portal, and agerm40 has a hole at a premium position.

quote.text: Teams are going to call him all week. He has a market.

557723610:gone:2027.h: L. Andrews leaves Penn State as the scheme-fit warning comes true
557723610:gone:2027.d: Andrews was flagged for a week as a bad fit for the scheme. He is now in the portal, adding to a rough run for agerm40.

quote.text: It never really clicked for him.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557721477:gone:2027.h: T. St. Clair, under fire for his numbers, enters the portal
557721477:gone:2027.d: St. Clair had been flagged for a week while taking heat for his production. He is gone from Ohio State, one more quarterback question for Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He knew it was time for a fresh start.
quote.by: a person close to the player

557717043:struggling.h: Is LSU ready to move on from running back D. Jones?
557717043:struggling.d: Jones has 69 carries for 230 yards, just 3.3 a carry. That is not enough for an 85-overall back on a ranked team, and the staff has a big decision to make before next season.

quote.text: The production just hasn't matched the rating.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557725326:struggling.h: R. Marriott's Stat Line Doesn't Match His 89 Rating
557725326:struggling.d: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]] has thrown 13 touchdowns against 14 interceptions, and the staff is reportedly weighing quarterback options in the portal. An 89-overall passer isn't supposed to look like this.

quote.text: The talent is obvious. The decisions aren't, and the coaches have noticed.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557722672:struggling.h: Ratings say 86. The stat sheet says something else for J. Washington
557722672:struggling.d: Washington has 106 carries for 421 yards, 4.0 a carry, which falls short of what an 86-overall back should deliver. The staff has a big decision to make before next season.

quote.text: The rating says one thing. The tape says another.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557719383:stayed:2027.h: I. Obidegwu stays at Oregon after a month on Portal Watch
557719383:stayed:2027.d: [[p:557719383|I.Obidegwu]] sat on the list for four weeks as a questionable scheme fit. The portal is open and he's still on the [[t:832438364|Oregon]] roster. A raise in NIL, from 155K to 195K, seems to have helped.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557718302:underpaid.h: J. Mbatchou is playing for nothing. Florida is one team that could change that
557718302:underpaid.d: [[p:557718302|J.Mbatchou]] is an 85-overall defensive tackle with no NIL deal, while comparable players command around 105K. Per one source, [[t:832438308|Florida]] has been mentioned by agents as a suitor with the cash to close that gap.

quote.text: A guy rated like that doesn't stay unpaid once the portal calls start.
quote.by: an agent who works with SEC players

557725988:underpaid.h: A. Rowden is a bargain at Texas Tech, and rivals know it
557725988:underpaid.d: [[p:557725988|A.Rowden]] is an 84-overall running back who makes nothing in NIL, while players like him get around 85K. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has deep pockets, which is the only reason that gap hasn't already cost them.

quote.text: If I'm his agent, I'm making calls this week.

557723756:underpaid.h: Rival collectives are circling James Madison's K. Billiot
557723756:underpaid.d: [[p:557723756|K.Billiot]] is an 86-overall receiver with no NIL deal, while his peers get around 90K. [[t:832438323|James Madison]] ranks 80th in NIL spending and isn't built for a bidding war. Several bigger collectives are reportedly aware of the gap.

quote.text: You can't pay him what the big boys will. That's just reality.
quote.by: a source familiar with JMU's NIL operation

557719085:buried.h: K. Mothudi is too good to sit. A transfer looks likely
557719085:buried.d: [[p:557719085|K.Mothudi]] is an 84-overall junior middle linebacker who played just 86 snaps in 13 games. Staffs in the portal market have noticed, and one told us he would start for them tomorrow.

quote.text: He's a starter everywhere but where he is.

557712371:sinking.h: K. Blackwell is wasted on a 4-8 Kentucky team and could be the portal's top prize
557712371:sinking.d: [[p:557712371|K.Blackwell]] is an 88-overall junior cornerback stuck on a Kentucky team that finished 4-8. If he enters the portal, he'd be the story of the offseason. Contenders needing secondary help are said to be waiting.

quote.text: Every contender with a hole at corner has his number written down.

561125249battle.h: Miami Holds Slim Edge for K. Kane, But Georgia Won't Go Away
561125249battle.d: The four-star back's recruitment is down to playing time, and [[t:832438337|Miami]] has a sliver of an advantage over [[t:832438312|Georgia]]. Missouri is still hanging around, and one more good week could settle it.

quote.text: He wants to know when he's touching the ball, not when he's earning it. Whoever sells that best wins.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

557722079:breakout.h: Freshman Tackle S. Orlando Is Playing Himself Into a Raise Northwestern May Not Afford
557722079:breakout.d: [[p:557722079|S.Orlando]] has jumped to 77 overall in a week and is still earning nothing in NIL. That makes [[t:832438356|Northwestern]]'s offensive line coach a nervous man, because the portal doesn't care how loyal a freshman is.

quote.text: You see a young tackle with that kind of film, you pick up the phone. Everybody's picking up the phone.

557720529:breakout.h: P. Carver's Leap Has Louisiana Tech Facing a Money Problem
557720529:breakout.d: [[p:557720529|P.Carver]] is up 15 points, to 78 overall, and the Impact-dev freshman receiver is not being paid. [[t:832438331|Louisiana Tech]] has little room to compete if a bigger collective comes calling, and one probably will.

quote.text: Every week he looks more like a guy who belongs somewhere else on Saturdays.

557714455:breakout.h: M. O'Dell Is Now an 80, and Texas State Better Have a Plan
557714455:breakout.d: The freshman receiver jumped 13 points and still isn't earning NIL money. [[p:557714455|M.O'Dell]] is the kind of breakout that gets noticed in the portal, and [[t:832438386|Texas State]] isn't built for a bidding war.

quote.text: Nobody's asking for the moon. A guy like that just wants to see the school notice.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557723934:breakout.h: Pittsburgh's D. Fort Has Become a Star at the Wrong Price
557723934:breakout.d: [[p:557723934|D.Fort]] is up 12 points to 85 overall, and the sophomore middle linebacker is still earning nothing. [[t:832438367|Pittsburgh]] will have to pay him soon or watch a bigger program do it for them.

quote.text: He's the middle of that defense. If he's not getting paid, somebody will tell him he should be.

557716252:breakout.h: Louisville Guard M. Ogundeji Is Rising Fast and Making Nothing
557716252:breakout.d: The Star-dev sophomore is now an 83 overall, up 12 points, and [[p:557716252|M.Ogundeji]] isn't seeing a dime of NIL. [[t:832438332|Louisville]] is not a place that wins bidding wars, and interior linemen like this get poached quietly.

quote.text: Guards don't get headlines. They get calls from agents and collectives, and he's about to start getting both.

557719613:buried.h: B. Ghee Has Barely Played, and the Portal Is Watching
557719613:buried.d: [[p:557719613|B.Ghee]] is an 83-overall sophomore edge rusher who has seen almost no snaps behind the guys ahead of him. Staffs shopping for pass rush would start him immediately, and he knows it.

quote.text: He's not complaining, but he's definitely counting how many teams need an edge.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557728693:fit.h: J. Washington Is Too Good for Oregon's Struggling Secondary
557728693:fit.d: Oregon's pass defense is near the bottom of the country, and [[p:557728693|J.Washington]], an 89-overall hybrid safety, is stuck in the middle of it. Players with that mismatch usually start asking what a different scheme could do for them.

quote.text: You're a top safety on a defense that gets torched through the air. Of course you wonder what else is out there.

557725988:buried.h: A. Rowden Is No. 2 on the Depth Chart and Getting Restless
557725988:buried.d: [[p:557725988|A.Rowden]], an 88-overall sophomore back, has barely seen the field at Texas Tech. Rival staffs are circling, and the longer he sits the harder it gets to keep him.

quote.text: He's an 88 and he's watching from the sideline. That doesn't last.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557727705:struggling.h: T. Hornes Is an 88 Who Hasn't Caught a Pass
557727705:struggling.d: [[p:557727705|T.Hornes]] has no catches in three games, which is not what you expect from an 88-overall receiver. The staff may look at the portal for help at the position, and the player himself might want a new start.

quote.text: You can't stay an 88 on paper if the ball never finds you.

557717941:buried.h: R. Lucas Is Too Good to Stay on the Bench
557717941:buried.d: [[p:557717941|R.Lucas]] is an 80-overall sophomore edge rusher with a lot of snaps but little to show for it. Other staffs would start him right away, and a transfer is a real possibility.

quote.text: He's producing in his role, but he wants to be the guy. That conversation is coming.
quote.by: a source close to the player

557712883:struggling.h: T. Beard Is an 86 With Zero Catches in 13 Games at LSU
557712883:struggling.d: [[t:832438333|LSU]] is ranked and loaded, and [[p:557712883|T.Beard]] has not caught a single pass. He'll have to win the job back in camp, and his patience may be gone before then.

quote.text: On a team like that, if you're not in the plan by now, you're probably not in the plan.

557725640:struggling.h: T. Norman Was Supposed to Be a Star, but the Production Isn't There
557725640:struggling.d: [[p:557725640|T.Norman]] is an 85-overall receiver on a ranked team with two catches in 13 games. He'll have to win the job back in camp, and some people around the program wonder whether he will.

quote.text: The talent is there. The usage just never showed up, and that gets frustrating.
quote.by: a source close to the program

557728716:sinking.h: R. Wesley Would Be the Portal's Top Prize if Michigan Lets Him Go
557728716:sinking.d: [[p:557728716|R.Wesley]] is an 89-overall sophomore edge rusher on a 2-10 Michigan team. If he hits the portal, it will be the story of the offseason, and every contender with a pass-rush hole will call.

quote.text: Guys like that don't stay on losing teams. He'll have a line of staffs waiting.

557716998:sinking.h: Michigan State's Z. Johnson Deserves a Contender
557716998:sinking.d: An 89-overall junior back stuck on a 4-9 team is exactly the kind of player the portal was made for. [[p:557716998|Z.Johnson]] is a name every contender knows, and Michigan State may not be able to keep him.

quote.text: He's carrying that offense and getting nothing for it. Of course teams are calling.
